dialogue.reisatsu.hint.chef: When the chef plates, he looks down. Try the pass window.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.child: When she hides, she covers her eyes. ...Find her.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.closing: The manager is awake. ...It is closing time.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.manager: The manager watches through the security cameras. Cut their power and he is blind.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.mirror_woman: The mirror in the women's restroom. While the water runs she bows and weeps. Hold your breath.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.return: When you have all of their photographs, give them to me.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.start: What the eye cannot see, the finder sometimes can.
dialogue.reisatsu.hint.visitor: At two the door opens. You should see table 7's customer in profile through the south window.

dialogue.reisatsu.intro.1: ...you came. I am Yakumo Toki. A medium.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.10: Keep your light low. Kill your footsteps. ...Go on.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.2: There are people in there who cannot go home. ...Six of them.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.3: If I go in, they will hide from me. That is why I need you.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.4: Take this. The reisha-ki - an old camera that photographs what the eye cannot see.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.5: If a spirit's face is in the photo, its name rises in red on the white margin.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.6: With the names I can send them on. Bring the photographs to me.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.7: Listen. They must not notice you. A spirit that has noticed you will not show in a photograph.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.8: Three ofuda. ...They will take your place three times. No more.
dialogue.reisatsu.intro.9: A flashlight, and the shop key. Turn the key switch by the entrance and the automatic doors will work.
dialogue.reisatsu.manager.closed: We are now closed for the day.
dialogue.reisatsu.pa.closed: We are now closed for the day.
dialogue.reisatsu.release.chef: Mr. Gondo. The fire is out now.
dialogue.reisatsu.release.manager: Mr. Morita. ...Thank you for all your hard work.
dialogue.reisatsu.release.mirror_woman: Reiko. We noticed you. We did.
dialogue.reisatsu.release.visitor: Mr. Miura. ...You don't have to wait any more.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.chef.1: Tsuyoshi Gondo. Fifty-two. The head chef.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.chef.2: 1996. He died in a grease fire in the kitchen. His face, his hands, all burnt.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.chef.3: He had asked them to clean the duct, again and again.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.chef.4: And still he stands at his board.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.child.2: 2001. She disappeared in this restaurant, in the middle of a game of hide-and-seek.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.child.4: She is still playing. Hiding so well, waiting for someone to find her.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.manager.2: For years he ran the nights alone. In 2019, at his desk in the office...
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.manager.3: Worked to death. ...After that, the store stopped opening at night.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.manager.4: But he is still closing the store. Every night.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.mirror_woman.2: 2015. A regular. She collapsed in the women's restroom, and nobody noticed until morning.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.mirror_woman.3: When they found her, the tap was still running.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.mirror_woman.4: Now she is on the other side of the mirror. ...All she wanted was for someone to notice.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.visitor.2: Tonight, in 2009. He was riding here at two in the morning to meet his girlfriend.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.visitor.3: At the curve out front... Since then, every night at two, the door opens.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.visitor.4: He presses the call button at table 7... still waiting for her.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.waitress.2: She was on the night shift that night. When the crash happened she ran out onto the road to help.
dialogue.reisatsu.submit.waitress.4: She is still working the night shift. Serving water to customers nobody else can see.
dialogue.reisatsu.waitress.single: Welcome. ...A table for one, isn't it.
dialogue.reisatsu.wake.3: There are no ofuda left. Next time I cannot save you.
ending.reisatsu.bad.1: ...when you come to, you are sitting at table 7.
ending.reisatsu.bad.3: A glass of ice water is set down in front of you.
ending.reisatsu.bad.4: From that night on, the call button at table 7 of HIDAMARI rings twice.
ending.reisatsu.good.2: The first trucks of the morning roll by on the highway.
ending.reisatsu.good.3: The light of the HIDAMARI sign quietly goes out.
ending.reisatsu.good.5: From that day on, the entrance chime never rang for nobody again.
ending.reisatsu.good.ofuda.0: - A perfect night. Six sent on, and not one ofuda burnt.
ending.reisatsu.good.ofuda.1: One ofuda turned to ash. Still, all six went home.
ending.reisatsu.good.ofuda.2: Two ofuda turned to ash. ...It was a close night.
ending.reisatsu.good.ofuda.3: Every last ofuda burnt. Maybe you only saw the morning by luck.
ending.reisatsu.title: REISATSU

intro.reisatsu.2:
HIDAMARI, a family restaurant on the national highway.
At the curve in front of it, people keep dying.
intro.reisatsu.3:
Since it stopped opening at night,
the closing crew keep seeing things.
intro.reisatsu.4:
The door they locked opens by itself. Taps run with nobody there.
The menus are found scattered across the floor.
intro.reisatsu.5: A medium hired you. You have come here.

note.reisatsu.clipping.body:
Two dead on the highway - motorcyclist and pedestrian
(regional page, November 4, 2009)

At about 2 a.m. on the 3rd, a motorcycle hit the guardrail on the stretch of highway known locally as "the devil's curve", killing its rider, Kenji Miura (24). Chinatsu Onodera (19), an employee of the nearby family restaurant who saw the accident and ran out to help, was struck by a following truck and died shortly after.

The curve has poor visibility and has seen a string of fatal accidents. Mr. Miura was on his way to meet his girlfriend, who was waiting for him at the restaurant.

Dec 2, 2009 - Repairman says: "nothing wrong"
Mar 14, 2010 - Table 7 rang again. Two o'clock sharp.
Aug 1, 2012 - To the new staff: if the restroom taps are running, don't worry about it.
Jun 20, 2015 - Women's stall 3 stays "occupied" and won't open. Nobody is in there (I think).
Jul 3, 2015 - Don't tell the new ones about the mirror.
Feb 9, 2018 - NEVER move Mr. Gondo's knife. If you do, it is back in its place the next day.
Oct 31, 2019 - The manager hasn't had a day off all month. Somebody cover for him.
Nov 2, 2019 - The manager is asleep in the office. Letting him sleep.
Nov 3, 2019 - 
Apr 1, 2020 - From today: no more night opening. We close at 1 a.m.
Nov 3, 2022 - After closing the automatic door opened. The chime rang. Nobody was there.
Oct 30, 2026 - Nobody wants the night shift any more.

note.reisatsu.medium.body:
On photographing them - Yakumo

I. Do not let a spirit notice you. A spirit that has noticed you will not show in a photograph.
II. They are keen to light and sound. Keep your light low and your steps silent.
III. Some can only be seen through the finder.
IV. If the face is not in the photo, no name will rise.
V. If they notice you: run. Hide. The ofuda will take your place three times, no more.

Bring the photographs to me. I will read their names and send them on.
Hold your breath (V) and your presence fades. Not for long.
The staff will have written down what happens in there. Read it.
